name: agent_controls
description: Cross-SDK agent-run control fixtures: the sliding-window loop detector (LoopDetector / LoopDetector, owning control for reason code LOOP_DETECTED) and the delegation tracker (DelegationTracker / DelegationTracker, owning control for DELEGATION_BLOCKED). loop_cases drive recordIteration/record_iteration N times against one detector and pin the ordered result list, null meaning 'within limits'; every case uses a window far wider than the test takes to run, so a case is a pure count threshold and never a wall-clock race - the time-based pruning inside the window is deliberately NOT pinned here, because a fixture cannot pin a clock. delegation_cases drive recordDelegation/record_delegation over one tracker in order and pin the ordered violation list, message strings included: an operator reading policy_reason on an audit event must not be able to tell which SDK wrote it, and the circular message uses U+2192 as the chain separator in both. Check ORDER is part of what these pin - allowlist, then circularity, then depth - so a delegation that breaks two rules reports the same one everywhere. circular_chain_cases pin hasCircularDelegation/has_circular_delegation, the standalone chain check both SDKs export. Harnesses: sdk-typescript/tests/unit/agent-controls-conformance.test.ts, sdk-python/tests/test_agent_controls_conformance.py. Fixture keys are snake_case; the TypeScript config fields are maxIterations / windowMs / maxDepth / allowedDelegates / blockCircular and its result field is iterationCount, so the TS harness maps them.

loop_cases.note: The detector fires when the count EXCEEDS max_iterations, so a limit of 2 first fires on the 3rd iteration, reporting 3.
The detector reports the configured action; deciding what to do with it belongs to the caller, not the detector.

delegation_cases.note: The violation describes the delegation that was REFUSED, so chain and depth include the agent that never joined.

delegation_cases.note: An empty list is a declared allowlist, not an absent one.

delegation_cases.note: This delegation is both off-allowlist and past the depth limit; the check order decides which one the audit event names, so it is pinned.

delegation_cases.note: At max depth AND circular: circular wins.

delegation_cases.note: After a refusal the chain is unchanged, so the next legal delegation sits at the depth it would have had.
